name: Hot Rod Deluxe IV
description: 40-watt 1x12" tube combo with rich clean tones and harmonically rich overdrive.
detailedDescription: The Fender Hot Rod Deluxe IV is the industry standard for gigging guitarists. This 40-watt all-tube combo delivers pristine cleans and rich overdriven tones through its 12-inch Celestion speaker. The revised preamp circuit offers smoother distortion characteristics, while the onboard spring reverb adds dimensional depth to your sound.
speaker: 1x12" Celestion A-Type

name: Twin Reverb '65 Reissue
description: The industry standard for clean tone with abundant headroom.
detailedDescription: The Fender '65 Twin Reverb reissue faithfully reproduces the classic amp that defined the sound of countless recordings. With 85 watts of tube power pushing two 12-inch Jensen speakers, it delivers pristine clean tones with remarkable headroom. The onboard tube-driven spring reverb and vibrato effects add vintage dimension to your playing.
speaker: 2x12" Jensen C-12K

name: JCM800 2203 Reissue
description: Legendary rock amp head with iconic crunch and character.
detailedDescription: The Marshall JCM800 2203 reissue captures the legendary sound that defined rock and metal throughout the '80s. This 100-watt tube head delivers everything from mild crunch to aggressive distortion with incredible dynamic response. Pair it with a 4x12 cabinet for the full stack experience that's powered countless arena rock shows.
speaker: None (head only)

name: DSL40CR
description: Versatile tube combo with classic and modern Marshall tones.
detailedDescription: The Marshall DSL40CR brings together classic and contemporary Marshall tones in a practical 40-watt package. With two channels (clean/crunch and overdrive) and multiple gain stages, it covers everything from pristine cleans to high-gain metal. The Celestion V-Type speaker delivers balanced projection, while onboard digital reverb adds depth to your sound.
speaker: 1x12" Celestion V-Type

name: AC30C2
description: Iconic British chime and warm breakup in a powerful combo.
detailedDescription: The Vox AC30C2 delivers the quintessential British tone that defined countless classic recordings. Its EL84 power tubes produce the signature chime and harmonically rich breakup that respond beautifully to playing dynamics. With 30 watts pushing two 12-inch Celestion Greenback speakers, it provides plenty of presence on stage while retaining that coveted Vox character.
speaker: 2x12" Celestion Greenback

name: Archon 50 Head
description: Versatile high-gain tube head with exceptional clarity.
detailedDescription: The PRS Archon 50 delivers high-gain performance with remarkable clarity and articulation. With 50 watts of 6L6 tube power, it provides plenty of punch and headroom, while the lead channel offers thick, harmonic distortion that maintains note definition even with extreme gain settings. The clean channel is equally impressive, with crystalline clarity and sweet harmonic overtones.
speaker: None (head only)

name: Mark Five:35 Head
description: Compact powerhouse with legendary Mesa/Boogie tones.
detailedDescription: The Mesa/Boogie Mark Five:35 packs the legendary Mark Series tones into a compact 35-watt package. With two independent channels featuring switchable modes (Clean, Fat, Crunch, Mark IIC+, Mark IV, Extreme), it delivers incredible tonal versatility. The CabClone IR technology allows for direct recording or playing silently through headphones without sacrificing tone quality.
speaker: None (head only)

name: Plexi 1959SLP
description: Authentic reissue of the legendary late '60s amplifier.
detailedDescription: The Marshall 1959SLP Plexi reissue faithfully recreates the amp that defined the sound of rock in the late '60s. This 100-watt head delivers the raw, harmonically rich tone with a dynamic response that made the original so legendary. The simple control layout belies its versatility - from bluesy warmth to aggressive rock crunch, it's all in your hands and guitar volume.
speaker: None (head only)

name: Katana-100/212 MKII
description: Feature-packed digital combo with excellent sounds and effects.
detailedDescription: The Boss Katana-100/212 MKII represents the pinnacle of affordable digital amplification. With five amp characters (Clean, Crunch, Lead, Brown, Acoustic), over 60 built-in effects, and 100 watts of power through dual 12-inch speakers, it delivers exceptional tone and versatility at a fraction of the price of a tube setup. The USB connectivity allows deep editing and direct recording.
speaker: 2x12" Custom

name: TH30 Head
description: Versatile tube head with distinctive Orange character.
detailedDescription: The Orange TH30 offers the brand's signature midrange focus and harmonic richness in a versatile 30-watt package. Its two independent channels provide everything from pristine cleans to grinding high gain, with the shape control on the dirty channel allowing for extensive tonal sculpting. The half-power switch lets you knock the output down to 15 watts for recording or smaller venues.
speaker: None (head only)

name: Quad Cortex
description: Cutting-edge digital modeler with unparalleled realism.
detailedDescription: The Neural DSP Quad Cortex represents the bleeding edge of digital amp and effects modeling. With four SHARC DSP processors delivering unparalleled processing power, it captures the feel and response of tube amps with stunning realism. The intuitive touchscreen interface makes deep editing accessible, while the Capture technology lets you create models of your own gear.
speaker: None

name: Rockerverb 50 MKIII
description: Professional grade tube head with Orange's signature midrange punch.
detailedDescription: The Orange Rockerverb 50 MKIII delivers the brand's signature sound with enhanced versatility. The clean channel ranges from pristine to edge-of-breakup warmth, while the dirty channel spans from classic rock crunch to modern high gain. With 50 watts of EL34 power, attenuator, and tube-buffered effects loop, it's a professional workhorse for stage and studio.
speaker: None (head only)

name: Rectifier Dual Rec
description: Industry standard high-gain head with massive low end.
detailedDescription: The Mesa/Boogie Dual Rectifier is a cornerstone of modern heavy music. With three channels and multiple modes, it spans the tonal spectrum from sparkling cleans to crushing high gain with the signature tight low end that revolutionized metal. The rectifier switching between tube and solid-state allows for vintage sag or percussive attack.
speaker: None (head only)

name: Blues Junior IV
description: Compact tube combo with incredible tones and portability.
detailedDescription: The Fender Blues Junior IV delivers remarkable tube tone in a compact, gig-friendly package. With 15 watts of EL84 power pushing a 12-inch Celestion speaker, it produces warm cleans and responsive overdrive that's perfect for bars and small venues. The revised preamp circuit offers enhanced clarity, while the fat switch adds midrange punch when needed.
speaker: 1x12" Celestion A-Type

name: Origin 20H
description: Vintage-inspired tube head with modern features.
detailedDescription: The Marshall Origin 20H captures the spirit of classic Marshall tone in a modern package. Its EL34-driven power amp delivers the harmonically rich crunch that made Marshall famous, while the power reduction options let you dial in power amp distortion at neighbor-friendly volumes. The tilt control blends between bright and normal preamp voicings for enhanced tonal flexibility.
speaker: None (head only)

name: Kemper Profiler Stage
description: Professional-grade amp modeler in a floor unit format.
detailedDescription: The Kemper Profiler Stage brings the revolutionary profiling technology to a convenient floor unit. With thousands of available profiles capturing the exact sound and response of real amps, it delivers unprecedented tonal flexibility for the gigging guitarist. The built-in effects, expression pedal, and intuitive interface make it a complete solution for the modern musician.
speaker: None
